description: A legend's swatches are painted the way the marks they stand for are painted, and the whole configuration chain decides that. `symbols` in `legend/encode.ts` opens with `applyMarkConfig({}, model, FILL_STROKE_CONFIG)`, which asks `getMarkConfig` for each of the nine stroke and fill properties — and `getMarkConfig` reads a **style block first**, then `config[marktype]`, then `config.mark`. This compiler asked the flattened table of the last two, which has no styles in it at all, so a chart whose marks name a style that outlines them left its swatches unoutlined; and where the style was the only thing painting them, the legend came out with no `encode` block whatsoever rather than with the wrong one. The first row is that case: a bar outlined by `config.style.bar`, whose size legend must carry the same outline. The second is the case that must not move — the legend explaining the **colour** itself, where the mark's own fill is taken off the swatch because a swatch cannot show a scale it is itself the key to. Note what it still keeps: the outline is not the colour, so the stroke stays while the fill goes. A row naming a style of its own is drawn in `a-legend-symbol-wears-a-styles-stroke` rather than here, because two size legends over the same field are hoisted into one and the second row's style would never reach a legend at all.
